name: Before a Fall
source:
After waking up on a battlefield covered with bodies, you find that the evils your Order kept imprisoned since the Great War have been unleashed upon the world once more...

Now it is up to you to find a way to save the Realms and avenge your fallen brethren by solving the riddle of the Ancients!

[From [url=https://twoflowergames.itch.io/beforeafall]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在尸横遍野的战场醒来后，你发现，自大战以来一直被所属组织囚禁的邪恶存在已再度降临世间……

如今，你必须解开古人的谜题，找到拯救诸界的方法，为死去的同袍复仇！

[摘自[url=https://twoflowergames.itch.io/beforeafall]itch.io[/url]]
